actual_scope: Can the production joint-dual serialized-word replay (scripts/experiments/binary_frame_replay.py:replay, exercised by make joint-dual-verify on certificates/joint-dual-word-{23,25}.json.gz) adopt the exact containment-mask scan from research/joint-dual-replay-fast/ so the shipped verify path is faster while every assertion, check_word control, full-basis orientation and compiler replay receipt stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling make verify poles and scanning proved opt-in adapters still pairwise/slow on the shipped path. Leave-alone objects (#1922 joint frames, #2054/#2150 shared/mixed-point, #2100 ternary, #2117 DisjointTensor.frame_data, #2194 production verify_factor, #2210 production leech_minor, #2231 production sparse-fusion orbits, #1861 parity-side, quadratic-affine deferred for #1076) were not reopened. Aaron Wang's incorporated joint-dual-replay-fast adapter already proved an opt-in identical-receipt accelerator; production still used the O(outputs x triples) literal scans.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: joint-dual-verify is part of make verify-joint. Faster identical replay receipts do not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing
evidence: PASS_JOINT_DUAL_REPLAY_PRODUCTION via research/joint-dual-replay-production/verify.py (also -O policy control); PASS_IDENTICAL_JOINT_DUAL_REPLAY_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; compiler replay receipts unchanged; SOURCE/kappa/skip-frame pins updated only for the production source digest.
author: Wentao Li
